Product Description
Vintage Western Display Font – OTF Only
Give your designs a bold, rugged, and vintage character with this unique Western-inspired display font. Featuring tall decorative letterforms, engraved-style interior details, ornamental strokes, and a classic woodcut aesthetic, this typeface is perfect for projects that need an authentic Old West and handcrafted feel.
The detailed lettering makes it especially effective for logos, posters, apparel, packaging, signage, and eye-catching typography.
Perfect For:
Western & Cowboy Logos
T-Shirt & Apparel Designs
Vintage Posters
Rustic Branding
Signage & Badges
Farm & Ranch Designs
Packaging Design
Labels & Product Branding
Greeting Cards
Invitations
Posters & Headlines
Stickers & Merchandise
Cricut & Craft Projects
Font Features:
✔ Vintage Western-inspired style
✔ Decorative engraved details
✔ Tall and elegant display letterforms
✔ Rustic woodcut appearance
